name: How long does a basement remodel usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a basement remodel usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a basement remodel depends on its complexity and size, but a typical project can take anywhere from 4 to 12 weeks. This timeline includes planning, permitting, construction, and finishing touches. Projects involving extensive demolition, new plumbing or electrical installations, or custom cabinetry will naturally take longer. We work with clients in areas like Garden City and Kuna to establish a realistic timeline upfront and keep you informed of progress.
